data.name: ZEROSEGI
data.detailed_description:
You are thrust into the entrance ceremony of the unfamiliar Seiria Magic Academy. In just one week, the "Violet Eclipse"—a festival held only once every century—will begin. Immerse yourself in the bustling preparations and enjoy your new campus life. Fall deeply in love with seven charming heroines and uncover the colossal secrets of this world along the way. Every choice you make and every record you keep will accumulate to forge an ending that reshapes the fate of the world.

Your new campus life starts here. Guided by a Game Master (GM) and the thrill of TRPG-style dice checks, your every action is determined by chance and choice. Who will you spend your day with? Will you head to the auditorium, the hallway, the classroom, or venture out into the city? You design your daily schedule, freely initiating conversations and building relationships with those around you.

While everyone is buzzing with excitement for the upcoming festival, you will encounter seven unique heroines. Through small talk and shared promises, feelings will deepen, eventually blossoming into a special romance. However, hidden within this peaceful academy lies a massive secret waiting to be unearthed. Romance follows the path of love, while the world follows the flow of destiny—these two stories will intertwine, changing the course of your day.

Key Features

  • Campus Life: Fixed classes, lunch breaks, festival preparations, and club activities! Just like in real life, these are "mandatory," but whether you actually participate is entirely up to you.

  • Living NPCs: They don’t just stand around; they roam the campus. Introduce yourself to the seven heroines hidden somewhere in the school, share secrets, and develop deep relationships.

  • The Veteran Game Master: Whenever you attempt a challenge, the Game Master’s dice check awaits. If he ever makes a mistake, feel free to complain: "Hey, where did my XP go?"

  • The Fate of the World: As you enjoy your day-to-day campus life, you may eventually come face-to-face with the grand secrets and destiny of this world.

data.short_description: A TRPG × Visual Novel led by the roll of the dice. You arrive at Seiria Magic Academy just one week before the centennial 'Violet Eclipse.' Immerse yourself in campus life, romance seven heroines, and uncover the world's hidden secrets. Your choices alone will reshape the fate of this world.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 or 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Storage: 5 GB available space
